experiment_data.hypothesis: Scale attenuation at 14B (44.1% 4-class) is primarily caused by reference-model mismatch (Pythia-1.4B cross-ref). Qwen2.5-7B FP16 self-reference should recover depth signal: if acc ≥60% proves mismatch is the bottleneck; if ≥70% confirms scale-matched reference yields results comparable to 1-1.5B self-ref (78.4% mean). Previous 7B QLoRA with Pythia cross-ref got 60.1% — FP16 + self-ref should outperform.
